title: The Pier Box Answers In MY Handwriting 🗝️
description:
The lock-box on our pier answers whatever you ask, in your own handwriting, by morning. It has never once sent anybody two cards.

I asked whether to tell my best friend about the bike I've spent a year building him. Two mornings in a row it answered me, and the two cards disagree.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Which card did the box really write, 1 or 2? Comment the number and your clue.
